content.title: The Masked Singer Season 14 Finale: Winner Ashlee Simpson
content.text: Home TV News ‘The Masked Singer’ Finale Reveals Identities of Galaxy Girl, Pugcasso, Cat Witch and Crane, With Help From Jessica Simpson: Here’s Who Won Season 14 Fox SPOILER ALERT: Details follow for Season 14, Episode 12 of “The Masked Singer,” “Finals,” which aired March 25 on Fox. The stars aligned for Ashlee Simpson, who was unmasked on the Season 14 finale of Fox’s “The Masked Singer” as Galaxy Girl, this season’s champion and winner of the golden ‘Masked’ trophy. Also revealed on Wednesday’s episode: Phillip Phillips as Pugcasso, Kylie Cantrall as Cat Witch and Normani as Crane. Related Stories Simpson won it all following two finale numbers: “Good 4 U,” by Olivia Rodrigo, and “Try,” by Pink. Among the panelists, Jenny McCarthy-Wahlberg, Rita Ora, Robin Thicke and Ken Jeong all got it right with Ashlee Simpson — especially since her sister Jessica Simpson came out on stage before the final guess. Popular on Variety 1/1 Skip Ad Continue watchingafter the adVisit Advertiser websiteGO TO PAGE “It was nice to have my sister there that day and have her support,” Simpson told Variety. “I had a blast doing the show. For me, just having the freedom of performing with the mask on, and discovering my love for performing again and what joy it brought out of me. This makes me want to keep going. It’s nice to receive the love from the audience, to be back on stage.” In second place, Phillips wrapped it up with “True Colors,” by Cyndi Lauper, and “Sussudio,” by Phil Collins. McCarthy-Wahlberg got it right with Phillips. Ora thought it was Chris Allen. Thicke said Justin Guarini, Jeong picked Bo Bice. For third place, Cantrall — who had already been revealed throughout the season to viewers — was finally unmasked to the panelists as Cat Witch. She finished by singing “Leave (Get Out),” by Jojo, and “Greedy,” by Tate McRae. Ora got it right with her “Descendants” co-star Cantrall, and McCarthy-Wahlberg agreed. Jeong went with Ashley Tisdale, Thicke said Victoria Justice. The first unmasking of the night was Crane, who sang “Together Again,” by Janet Jackson earlier in the evening. For Crane, Ora got it right with Normani, and both McCarthy-Wahlberg and Thicke agreed. Jeong thought it was Kelly Rowland. Ashlee Simpson (Galaxy Girl), Phillip Phillips (Pugcasso), Kylie Cantrall (Cat Witch) and Normani (Crane) join Rachel Platten (Pangolin), Evan Ross-Næss (Stingray), Judge Greg Mathis (14 Karat Carrot), Alexi Lalas (High Voltage), Jack Wagner (Eggplant), Heidi Montag (Snow Cone), Billy Ray Cyrus (Owl), Teddi Mellencamp (Calla Lily), Claudia Oshry (Queen Corgi), Taraji P. Henson (Scarab), Tone Loc (Handyman), Tiffany Haddish (Le Who Who), Todd and Julie Chrisley (Croissants) and David “Big Papi” Ortiz (Googly Eyes) as the celebrities unmasked on “The Masked Singer” Season 14. Back for Season 14 are panelists McCarthy Wahlberg, Jeong, Ora and Thicke. New this season is “America’s Insider,” in which singer, dancer and social media personality Kylie Cantrall shared behind-the-scenes hints and clues for viewers. The twist: Cantrall was in costume as Cat Witch, but only unmasked for viewers — so the audience knew who she was, but the panelists didn’t. “The Masked Singer” Season 14 themed episodes included a tribute to “Star Trek,” the ‘90s comedy “Clueless,” the comic franchise “Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles” and the blockbuster “Twilight Saga” films. Also Fox’s new “Fear Factor” reboot featured host Johnny Knoxville in a “Fear Factor: House of Fear Night,” and an “Ozzfest Night” honored late rocker Ozzy Osbourne, including a special tribute by “Masked Singer” alum Kelly Osbourne (Season 2’s Ladybug) saluting her father’s musical influence. The 18 Masked contestants in Season 14 included Eggplant, Pugcasso, Queen Corgi, the Croissants, Owl, 14 Karat Carrot, Snow Cone, Galaxy Girl, High Voltage, Googly Eyes, Scarab, Handyman, Crane, Le Who Who, Pangolin, Stingray, Cat Witch and Calla Lily. Per the show, the Season 14 contestants have sold a combined 94 million records, received 47 Teen Choice Award nominations, 12 Emmy nominations, two stars on the Hollywood Walk of Fame, one Tony Award win and one Academy Award nomination. Here were the performances on Wednesday’s finale episode. Galaxy Girl, “The Masked Singer” WINNER: Galaxy Girl Songs: “Good 4 U,” by Olivia Rodrigo; “Try,” by Pink Previous songs: “Super Graphic Ultra Modern Girl,” by Chappell Roan; “Just A Girl,” by No Doubt; “Drive,” by Incubus; Lights,” by Ellie Goulding; “Misery Business,” by Paramore Crack the Case Clue: Delivered by Jessica Simpson. “I could not be more proud. This is the moment. How amazing!” Clue: “All About Me.” “The book is just a little piece of her story, but an important one,” Jessica Simpson said. Previous panel guesses: Lindsay Lohan, Jennifer Love Hewitt, Emma Stone, Dixie D’Amelio, Anne Hathaway, Hillary Duff, Ashlee Simpson, Kate Hudson, Gwen Stefani, Taylor Momsen, Avril Lavigne, Aly Michalka Galaxy Girl voiceover: “I’ve been wanting to do the Masked Singer forever. And now that I’m in the finale, I can confidently say it’s more transformative than I ever imagined. It’s not always easy to put yourself out there. When I was young and reckless, I didn’t think twice. It felt like the world was mine. But then one moment changed everything. I was publicly humiliated. Called a fraud, a fake. It was devastating. I was so young, and I thought it would define me forever. From then on, I became cautious. Taking risks just wasn’t worth it. I focused on my family. Being a mom. The school lunches, the soccer pickups. Until one of my kids heard my old music, and couldn’t believe it was me. So, I started saying yes again. Being here I’ve been able to go back to being that fearless performer I was all those years ago. And put my past behind me for good. For now, winning that golden mask trophy would show my kids that taking risks is worth it. And that their mom is, and always has been, a total rock star.” Pugcasso, “The Masked Singer” 2nd Place: Pugcasso Song: “True Colors,” by Cyndi Lauper; “Sussudio,” by Phil Collins Previous songs: “Ordinary,” by Alex Warren; “Fake Plastic Trees,” by Radiohead; “Too Much,” by Spice Girls; “Dreams,” by the Cranberries; “Bad Dreams,” by Teddy Swims Crack the Case Clue: Delivered by BFF Randy Jackson. “Congrats on making it to the finale. I have to say, I’m not surprised, because it’s always been a yes for me, dawg. And now you’re a real dog!” Final clue: Golden ticket. “It takes me back to the golden opportunity that started it all.” Previous panel guesses: Dan Reynolds, Darren Criss, Ryan Tedder, Jack Johnson, Rob Thomas, Pat Monahan, Vance Joy, Charlie Puth, Gavin DeGraw, Jason Mraz, Shay Mooney Pugcasso voiceover: “This experience has been a roller coaster. I wasn’t sure what to make of this costume. A pug who paints? What even is that? I’m the guy who made a career out of performing with just a microphone and my guitar. After my first rehearsal, I was all turned around. I went back to my trailer and called my kids. They’re not used to their daddy being gone so long. Talking to them made me I needed to embrace this challenge. I spent so much of my career second guessing everything. The industry can rob you of so much joy. But where’s the best place to find it again? The Masked Singer! So, I decided to lean in and I’m a pug who paints, dangit! And I guess I even dance too. Tonight, the competition is on. I’m all in. For my kiddos.” Cat Witch, “The Masked Singer” 3rd Place: Cat Witch Song: “Leave (Get Out),” by Jojo; “Greedy,” by Tate McRae Previous songs: “Abracadabra,” by Lady Gaga; “Teenage Dream,” by Katy Perry; “It Will Rain,” by Bruno Mars; “Starships,” by Nicki Minaj; “Run to You,” by Whitney Houston Crack the Case Clue: Delivered by her “bestie,” Season 13 finalist Meg Donnelly. “It is no shock to me that you are in the finale because you are so hard working.” Here’s the clue: Mousetrap. “I’ve never been afraid of a mouse. In fact, one helped launch my whole career.” Previous panel guesses: Charli D’Amelio, Addison Rae, Lisa from Blackpink; Victoria Justice, Ashley Tisdale, Zendaya, Hailee Steinfeld,Jamie Lynn Spears, Katseye members, Vanessa Lachey, Noah Cyrus, Kylie Cantrall Cat Witch voiceover: “I was the little girl who would practice performances all day, waiting for my parents to come home from work to show them what I could do. I’ve always had big dreams, and they’re still coming true. The last few years have been a total whirlwind. I remember going out on Halloween and seeing all these little girls dressed up like me. And I’m so thankful. But it’s a lot of pressure. I’m growing up now, and trying to figure out who I am. To be taken seriously. Who knew becoming Cat Witch was exactly what I needed. Being here I’ve grown so much and learned that I’m confident, powerful, sexy, fun. And I’m ready for whatever’s next. But I’m going to miss this. It’s been the best experience.” Crane, “The Masked Singer” 4th Place: Crane Song: “Together Again,” by Janet Jackson Previous songs: “It’s Not Right But It’s Okay,” by Whitney Houston; “Say You’ll Be There,” by Spice Girls; “Good Luck, Babe!” by Chappell Roan; “Break Free,” by Ariana Grande Crack the Case Clue: Delivered by her “bestie,” Khalid. “I’m so proud of the Crane,” Khalid said. “The Crane is like my sister, we go way back. The Crane is one of the most hard working women in the industry and I’m so grateful to be standing by the Crane’s side.” Here’s what was inside: VMA, AMA, Guinness World Records, Kids Choice Award. “It’s not easy winning all these awards, but luckily, Crane had some help doing it.” Previous panel guesses: Misty Copeland, Mya, Ashanti, Keke Palmer, Ciara, Taylor Swift, Normani, Tate McCrae, Halle Bailey, SZA Crane voiceover: “The moment I got the call for The Masked Singer, I knew it would be a blast. But I had no idea it would be so healing. When I first rose to fame, I had my close friends by my side. Together, we dominated. I’m talking shopping sprees, world tours, sold out stadiums. But behind closed doors, I was suffering silently. The more fame we found together, the more it felt like the world was trying to rip us apart. And eventually, the world won. There is a lot that I had wished had been different. So when we recently had the chance to reunite, we worked it. With a birds eye view of the past, we did the best that we could with what we were given. The crane represents loyalty. And those are my girls forever. But it also represents good fortune. Longevity. This has been for me.” Past “The Masked Singer” winners include T-Pain as Monster (Season 1), Wayne Brady as Fox (Season 2), Kandi Burruss as Night Angel (Season 3), LeAnn Rimes as Sun (Season 4), Nick Lachey as Piglet (Season 5), Jewel as Queen of Hearts (Season 6), Teyana Taylor as Firefly (Season 7), Amber Riley as Harp (Season 8), Bishop Briggs as Medusa (Season 9), Ne-Yo as Cow (Season 10), Vanessa Hudgens as Goldfish (Season 11), Boyz II Men as Buffalos (Season 12) and Gretchen Wilson as Pearl (Season 13). “The Masked Singer” comes from Fox Alternative Entertainment. Rosie Seitchik, Craig Plestis and Cannon are executive producers, while Seitchik serves as showrunner. The series is based on the South Korean format created by Mun Hwa Broadcasting Corp.
